name: audit-fix-verify
summary: For security work. Audit all the code, fix each finding, then attack the fix.

roles.name: auditor
roles.job: Reads ALL the code, not only the parts in the report. Lists each security problem with its risk.

roles.name: fixer
roles.job: Fixes each finding with a standard, safe method.

roles.name: attacker
roles.job: Writes tests that try to exploit each finding. The tests must fail on the old code and pass on the fixed code.

steps.do: Check the report findings. Then review every function for other problems: injection, path handling, access control, secrets and crypto.
Fix each finding in AUDIT.md. Keep the normal features working.
Write an exploit test for each finding. Run all tests. Send problems back to the fixer.
Check that each finding has a fix and a test. Write the result.

rules: The fixer and the attacker can work at the same time.
Do not invent your own crypto. Use the standard library.
